fields.Name: T315 - Scheduling Create Job Required-Field Validation
fields.Description: Tests the ScheduledJobEditor CanSave gating (form-level required-field enablement of the Create button) — a distinct client-side validation path from the generated form's save-blocked-with-message validation.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and switch to the 'Scheduling' application, then open its 'Jobs' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Click 'New Job' to open the create slide-in editor. With the required fields (Name, Job Type, Cron Expression — each marked with a red asterisk) left blank, verify the 'Create' button is DISABLED (not clickable). Then type a value into the Name field (and if easy, pick a Job Type and enter a cron like '0 0 * * * *') and verify the 'Create' button becomes ENABLED. Observing the enabled-state change gated by the required fields is success — you do NOT need to finish creating the job.

judgeValidationCriteria: The create editor shows required fields marked with asterisks (Name, Job Type, Cron Expression)
With required fields blank the 'Create' button is disabled; after filling Name (and Job Type / cron) it becomes enabled
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
